design_rules: Prefer JLCPCB Basic parts when the electrical limits, package, temperature range, and noise or speed performance remain compatible; record Extended exceptions with an LCSC code.
Use 0402 or larger passives; do not use packages smaller than 0402.
Keep the photodiode-to-TIA summing node and the 33 kohm/120 pF feedback loop short, guarded from TX carrier and digital edges, and free of test-point stubs.
JLCPCB export must fail closed when DRC reports violations or unconnected pads; verify BOM and CPL designator coverage before fabrication.
Route the remote LED on the two-conductor 600 mm JST-GH harness and provide local connector strain relief.
